title: Shree Hanuman Chalisa
author: Goswami Tulsidas
source: Tulsidas's Hanuman Chalisa (16th century, public domain). Devanagari spelling reconciled against several published editions. English translation written for this app.

verses.original:
श्रीगुरु चरन सरोज रज निज मनु मुकुरु सुधारि ।
बरनउँ रघुबर बिमल जसु जो दायकु फल चारि ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrīguru charana saroja raja nija manu mukuru sudhāri |
baranaum̐ raghubara bimala jasu jo dāyaku phala chāri ||
verses.english: I polish the mirror of my mind with the dust of my Guru's lotus feet. Then I sing the spotless glory of Rama, the best of the Raghu line, who grants the four rewards of life: duty, wealth, desire, and liberation.

verses.original:
बुद्धिहीन तनु जानिके सुमिरौं पवन-कुमार ।
बल बुधि बिद्या देहु मोहिं हरहु कलेस बिकार ॥
verses.transliteration:
buddhihīna tanu jānike sumirauṃ pavana-kumāra |
bala budhi bidyā dehu mohiṃ harahu kalesa bikāra ||
verses.english: I know my mind is not wise, so I call on you, Hanuman, son of the Wind. Give me strength, understanding, and knowledge, and take away my pain and my faults.

verses.original:
जय हनुमान ज्ञान गुन सागर ।
जय कपीस तिहुँ लोक उजागर ॥१॥
verses.transliteration:
jaya hanumāna jñāna guna sāgara |
jaya kapīsa tihum̐ loka ujāgara ||1||
verses.english: Hail, Hanuman, sea of wisdom and virtue. Hail, Lord of the Monkeys, whose light fills the three worlds.

verses.original:
राम दूत अतुलित बल धामा ।
अञ्जनि-पुत्र पवनसुत नामा ॥२॥
verses.transliteration:
rāma dūta atulita bala dhāmā |
añjani-putra pavanasuta nāmā ||2||
verses.english: You are Rama's messenger, the home of strength beyond measure. You are known as Anjani's son and the Wind's son.

verses.original:
महाबीर बिक्रम बजरङ्गी ।
कुमति निवार सुमति के सङ्गी ॥३॥
verses.transliteration:
mahābīra bikrama bajaraṅgī |
kumati nivāra sumati ke saṅgī ||3||
verses.english: Great hero, mighty one, with a body hard as a thunderbolt: you drive out bad thinking and keep company with good thinking.

verses.original:
कञ्चन बरन बिराज सुबेसा ।
कानन कुण्डल कुञ्चित केसा ॥४॥
verses.transliteration:
kañchana barana birāja subesā |
kānana kuṇḍala kuñchita kesā ||4||
verses.english: Your skin is golden and your dress is fine. You wear earrings, and your hair is curled.

verses.original:
हाथ बज्र औ ध्वजा बिराजै ।
काँधे मूँज जनेऊ साजै ॥५॥
verses.transliteration:
hātha bajra au dhvajā birājai |
kām̐dhe mūm̐ja janeū sājai ||5||
verses.english: A thunderbolt and a flag are in your hands, and a sacred thread of munja grass rests on your shoulder.

verses.original:
सङ्कर सुवन केसरीनन्दन ।
तेज प्रताप महा जग बन्दन ॥६॥
verses.transliteration:
saṅkara suvana kesarīnandana |
teja pratāpa mahā jaga bandana ||6||
verses.english: Son of Shiva and joy of Kesari, your brilliance and power are honored by the whole world.

verses.original:
बिद्यावान गुनी अति चातुर ।
राम काज करिबे को आतुर ॥७॥
verses.transliteration:
bidyāvāna gunī ati chātura |
rāma kāja karibe ko ātura ||7||
verses.english: You are learned, virtuous, and very clever, and always eager to do Rama's work.

verses.original:
प्रभु चरित्र सुनिबे को रसिया ।
राम लखन सीता मन बसिया ॥८॥
verses.transliteration:
prabhu charitra sunibe ko rasiyā |
rāma lakhana sītā mana basiyā ||8||
verses.english: You love to hear the Lord's story. Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita live in your heart.

verses.original:
सूक्ष्म रूप धरि सियहिं दिखावा ।
बिकट रूप धरि लङ्क जरावा ॥९॥
verses.transliteration:
sūkṣma rūpa dhari siyahiṃ dikhāvā |
bikaṭa rūpa dhari laṅka jarāvā ||9||
verses.english: You took a tiny form and showed yourself to Sita. You took a fearsome form and burned Lanka.

verses.original:
भीम रूप धरि असुर सँहारे ।
रामचन्द्र के काज सँवारे ॥१०॥
verses.transliteration:
bhīma rūpa dhari asura sam̐hāre |
rāmachandra ke kāja sam̐vāre ||10||
verses.english: You took a huge, terrifying form and struck down the demons, and you carried out Rama's tasks.

verses.original:
लाय सञ्जीवन लखन जियाये ।
श्रीरघुबीर हरषि उर लाये ॥११॥
verses.transliteration:
lāya sañjīvana lakhana jiyāye |
śrīraghubīra haraṣi ura lāye ||11||
verses.english: You brought the sanjivani herb and brought Lakshmana back to life. Glad, Raghuvir held you to his heart.

verses.original:
रघुपति कीन्ही बहुत बड़ाई ।
तुम मम प्रिय भरतहि सम भाई ॥१२॥
verses.transliteration:
raghupati kīnhī bahuta baḍāī |
tuma mama priya bharatahi sama bhāī ||12||
verses.english: Raghupati praised you warmly and said, "You are as dear to me as my brother Bharata."

verses.original:
सहस बदन तुम्हरो जस गावैं ।
अस कहि श्रीपति कण्ठ लगावैं ॥१३॥
verses.transliteration:
sahasa badana tumharo jasa gāvaiṃ |
asa kahi śrīpati kaṇṭha lagāvaiṃ ||13||
verses.english: "A thousand mouths sing your fame," he said, and the Lord of Shri drew you close in an embrace.

verses.original:
सनकादिक ब्रह्मादि मुनीसा ।
नारद सारद सहित अहीसा ॥१४॥
verses.transliteration:
sanakādika brahmādi munīsā |
nārada sārada sahita ahīsā ||14||
verses.english: Sanaka and the other sages, Brahma and the gods, the great seers, Narada, Sarada, and the Lord of Serpents,

verses.original:
जम कुबेर दिगपाल जहाँ ते ।
कबि कोबिद कहि सके कहाँ ते ॥१५॥
verses.transliteration:
jama kubera digapāla jahām̐ te |
kabi kobida kahi sake kahām̐ te ||15||
verses.english: Yama, Kubera, and the guardians of the directions cannot tell your glory in full. How could poets and scholars?

verses.original:
तुम उपकार सुग्रीवहिं कीन्हा ।
राम मिलाय राज पद दीन्हा ॥१६॥
verses.transliteration:
tuma upakāra sugrīvahiṃ kīnhā |
rāma milāya rāja pada dīnhā ||16||
verses.english: You did Sugriva a great favor. You brought him to Rama, and he was given a kingdom and a throne.

verses.original:
तुम्हरो मन्त्र बिभीषन माना ।
लङ्केस्वर भए सब जग जाना ॥१७॥
verses.transliteration:
tumharo mantra bibhīṣana mānā |
laṅkesvara bhae saba jaga jānā ||17||
verses.english: Vibhishana followed your advice and became king of Lanka. The whole world knows it.

verses.original:
जुग सहस्र जोजन पर भानू ।
लील्यो ताहि मधुर फल जानू ॥१८॥
verses.transliteration:
juga sahasra jojana para bhānū |
līlyo tāhi madhura phala jānū ||18||
verses.english: The sun is many thousands of yojanas away, yet you swallowed it, taking it for a sweet fruit.

verses.original:
प्रभु मुद्रिका मेलि मुख माहीं ।
जलधि लाँघि गये अचरज नाहीं ॥१९॥
verses.transliteration:
prabhu mudrikā meli mukha māhīṃ |
jaladhi lām̐ghi gaye acharaja nāhīṃ ||19||
verses.english: With the Lord's ring held in your mouth, you leapt across the ocean. That is no surprise.

verses.original:
दुर्गम काज जगत के जेते ।
सुगम अनुग्रह तुम्हरे तेते ॥२०॥
verses.transliteration:
durgama kāja jagata ke jete |
sugama anugraha tumhare tete ||20||
verses.english: Every hard task in the world becomes easy through your grace.

verses.original:
राम दुआरे तुम रखवारे ।
होत न आज्ञा बिनु पैसारे ॥२१॥
verses.transliteration:
rāma duāre tuma rakhavāre |
hota na ājñā binu paisāre ||21||
verses.english: You are the guard at Rama's door. No one enters without your permission.

verses.original:
सब सुख लहै तुम्हारी सरना ।
तुम रच्छक काहू को डर ना ॥२२॥
verses.transliteration:
saba sukha lahai tumhārī saranā |
tuma racchaka kāhū ko ḍara nā ||22||
verses.english: Everyone who comes to you for refuge finds joy. With you as their guardian, they have nothing to fear.

verses.original:
आपन तेज सम्हारो आपै ।
तीनों लोक हाँक तें काँपै ॥२३॥
verses.transliteration:
āpana teja samhāro āpai |
tīnoṃ loka hām̐ka teṃ kām̐pai ||23||
verses.english: Only you can hold back your own power. At your roar, the three worlds shake.

verses.original:
भूत पिसाच निकट नहिं आवै ।
महाबीर जब नाम सुनावै ॥२४॥
verses.transliteration:
bhūta pisācha nikaṭa nahiṃ āvai |
mahābīra jaba nāma sunāvai ||24||
verses.english: The hymn says that ghosts and evil spirits do not come near when the name of the great hero is spoken.

verses.original:
नासै रोग हरै सब पीरा ।
जपत निरन्तर हनुमत बीरा ॥२५॥
verses.transliteration:
nāsai roga harai saba pīrā |
japata nirantara hanumata bīrā ||25||
verses.english: The hymn says that illness is destroyed and every pain is taken away for those who keep repeating the name of brave Hanuman.

verses.original:
सङ्कट तें हनुमान छुड़ावै ।
मन क्रम बचन ध्यान जो लावै ॥२६॥
verses.transliteration:
saṅkaṭa teṃ hanumāna chuḍāvai |
mana krama bachana dhyāna jo lāvai ||26||
verses.english: Hanuman frees from trouble the person who fixes mind, deed, and word on him.

verses.original:
सब पर राम तपस्वी राजा ।
तिन के काज सकल तुम साजा ॥२७॥
verses.transliteration:
saba para rāma tapasvī rājā |
tina ke kāja sakala tuma sājā ||27||
verses.english: Rama, the ascetic, is king over all, and you carry out all of his tasks.

verses.original:
और मनोरथ जो कोई लावै ।
सोई अमित जीवन फल पावै ॥२८॥
verses.transliteration:
aura manoratha jo koī lāvai |
soī amita jīvana phala pāvai ||28||
verses.english: Whoever brings any other wish to you gains the full, boundless fruit of life.

verses.original:
चारों जुग परताप तुम्हारा ।
है परसिद्ध जगत उजियारा ॥२९॥
verses.transliteration:
chāroṃ juga paratāpa tumhārā |
hai parasiddha jagata ujiyārā ||29||
verses.english: Your glory spreads through all four ages. It is famous, a light across the world.

verses.original:
साधु सन्त के तुम रखवारे ।
असुर निकन्दन राम दुलारे ॥३०॥
verses.transliteration:
sādhu santa ke tuma rakhavāre |
asura nikandana rāma dulāre ||30||
verses.english: You protect the good and the holy, you crush demons, and you are Rama's beloved.

verses.original:
अष्टसिद्धि नौ निधि के दाता ।
अस बर दीन जानकी माता ॥३१॥
verses.transliteration:
aṣṭasiddhi nau nidhi ke dātā |
asa bara dīna jānakī mātā ||31||
verses.english: You can give the eight powers and the nine treasures. Mother Janaki gave you this boon.

verses.original:
राम रसायन तुम्हरे पासा ।
सदा रहो रघुपति के दासा ॥३२॥
verses.transliteration:
rāma rasāyana tumhare pāsā |
sadā raho raghupati ke dāsā ||32||
verses.english: You hold the elixir of devotion to Rama, and you always remain Raghupati's servant.

verses.original:
तुम्हरे भजन राम को पावै ।
जनम जनम के दुख बिसरावै ॥३३॥
verses.transliteration:
tumhare bhajana rāma ko pāvai |
janama janama ke dukha bisarāvai ||33||
verses.english: By devotion to you, a person finds Rama and forgets the sorrows of life after life.

verses.original:
अन्त काल रघुबर पुर जाई ।
जहाँ जन्म हरिभक्त कहाई ॥३४॥
verses.transliteration:
anta kāla raghubara pura jāī |
jahām̐ janma haribhakta kahāī ||34||
verses.english: At life's end that person goes to Raghubar's city, and in later births is known as a devotee of Hari.

verses.original:
और देवता चित्त न धरई ।
हनुमत सेइ सर्ब सुख करई ॥३५॥
verses.transliteration:
aura devatā chitta na dharaī |
hanumata sei sarba sukha karaī ||35||
verses.english: There is no need to keep any other god in mind. Serving Hanuman brings every happiness.

verses.original:
सङ्कट कटै मिटै सब पीरा ।
जो सुमिरै हनुमत बलबीरा ॥३६॥
verses.transliteration:
saṅkaṭa kaṭai miṭai saba pīrā |
jo sumirai hanumata balabīrā ||36||
verses.english: Trouble is cut away and all pain is wiped out for the one who remembers mighty, brave Hanuman.

verses.original:
जय जय जय हनुमान गोसाईं ।
कृपा करहु गुरुदेव की नाईं ॥३७॥
verses.transliteration:
jaya jaya jaya hanumāna gosāīṃ |
kṛpā karahu gurudeva kī nāīṃ ||37||
verses.english: Glory, glory, glory to you, Lord Hanuman. Be kind to me, as a guru is to a student.

verses.original:
जो सत बार पाठ कर कोई ।
छूटहि बन्दि महा सुख होई ॥३८॥
verses.transliteration:
jo sata bāra pāṭha kara koī |
chūṭahi bandi mahā sukha hoī ||38||
verses.english: The hymn says that whoever recites this a hundred times is freed from bonds and finds great happiness.

verses.original:
जो यह पढ़ै हनुमान चालीसा ।
होय सिद्धि साखी गौरीसा ॥३९॥
verses.transliteration:
jo yaha paḍhai hanumāna chālīsā |
hoya siddhi sākhī gaurīsā ||39||
verses.english: Whoever reads this Hanuman Chalisa will succeed, and Shiva, Lord of Gauri, is the witness.

verses.original:
तुलसीदास सदा हरि चेरा ।
कीजै नाथ हृदय महँ डेरा ॥४०॥
verses.transliteration:
tulasīdāsa sadā hari cherā |
kījai nātha hṛdaya maham̐ ḍerā ||40||
verses.english: Tulsidas is forever the servant of Hari. Lord, make your home in my heart.

verses.original:
पवनतनय सङ्कट हरन मङ्गल मूरति रूप ।
राम लखन सीता सहित हृदय बसहु सुर भूप ॥
verses.transliteration:
pavanatanaya saṅkaṭa harana maṅgala mūrati rūpa |
rāma lakhana sītā sahita hṛdaya basahu sura bhūpa ||
verses.english: Son of the Wind, remover of trouble, embodiment of all that is auspicious, live in my heart with Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita, king of the gods.
